svg.title: Animated agent loop
svg.desc: One example run through the siliconboard agent loop: Spec, RTL, Lint, Testbench and Simulate agents run in order. The simulation fails, the Debug agent patches the RTL, and the second pass continues through Synthesize, Timing and Report.
svg.text: Example run: simulation fails once, Debug patches the RTL, the second pass succeeds
A plain-English spec enters the loop
Spec Agent turns plain English into a design spec
RTL Agent proposes a Verilog module. LLM agents only propose
Lint: the Verilator exit code decides clean, not the model
Testbench Agent writes a testbench for the module
Simulate: the Verilator log says passed = false. The model can't overrule it
Debug Agent reads the failure and patches the RTL
The patched RTL goes back through the loop
Simulate: the Verilator log now says passed = true
Synthesize: a Yosys stat gives cell_count
Timing: an OpenSTA parse gives worst_slack_ns
Report Agent builds report.md from the artifacts
Every step is recorded in runs/<id>/board.json
